root.label: Texas Education Agency coordinates Alpha AI school pilots

events.label: Texas Education Agency coordinates Alpha AI school pilots

slots.name: districts approached
slots.sentence: The emails show that state education officials and Alpha affiliates approached at least 10 school districts about the AI program.

slots.name: states rejecting applications
slots.sentence: ProPublica and the Tribune recently reported that Texas was among at least nine states that rejected Alpha leaders’ applications to open publicly funded charter schools that would use its AI-driven learning tool, according to an Instagram post from the company’s co-founder.

slots.name: political donations
slots.sentence: Abbott, who has received over $1.5 million in political donations from Alpha co-founder MacKenzie Price, did not agree to an interview or directly answer whether he supports the AI platform in Texas schools.

slots.name: TEA leaders visiting
slots.sentence: Emails show the commissioner visited Alpha’s campuses again with six other TEA leaders.

slots.name: partnership status
slots.sentence: The TEA sent a written statement that said “there is no formal partnership between TEA and Alpha Schools.”

slots.name: 1882 partnership status
slots.sentence: As of August, the TEA said it could not find any documentation of Alpha or its other companies applying for or running an 1882 partnership.
